title: 心理学复现节选导读：重要性评分不能直接变成复现概率

source.name: Challenging the N-Heuristic — Li, Liu, Gao & Cohen (2024)，DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0306911
source.text:
Title: Challenging the N-Heuristic: Effect size, not sample size, predicts the replicability of psychological science
Authors: Xingyu Li, Jiting Liu, Weijia Gao, Geoffrey L. Cohen (2024)
DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0306911
Source: https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0306911
License: Copyright 2024 Li et al.; Creative Commons Attribution License, as stated on the publisher page. Original author and source must be credited.
Coverage: Selected sentences from Survey study, Fig 5 caption, and Discussion only; not the full paper or the replication-pair analysis.
Locations: Survey study (PDF page 10/15); Fig 5 caption (PDF page 11/15); Discussion limitations (PDF page 12/15).

[Survey study — recruitment and exclusion, selected sentences]
To address this question, we surveyed psychological scientists, broadly defined, by sending out invitation links to a survey about “replicability in psychological research” through social media platforms and the Society for Personality and Social Psychology listserv.
Ten undergraduate students replied to the survey and were excluded from all analyses, resulting in a final sample size of 215 psychological scientists.

[Survey study — randomized presentation and outcome, selected sentences]
We randomized the order of presentation of nine study criteria between participants, and for each one, they rated the extent to which they thought it predicted a study’s replicability on a 5-point scale, with higher numbers signifying greater importance.
Respondents rated “large sample size” as the most important criterion (M = 3.84), judging it to be significantly more important than the second most important factor, “large effect size” (M = 3.61), t(214) = 3.21, p = 0.002.

[Fig 5 — selected caption sentence]
Error bars represent ±1 SE.

[Discussion — selected limitation sentence]
First, the studies subjected to replication and our surveyed respondents were not representative samples.

[Coverage note written by the fixture author]
This survey measures researchers’ judgments, not actual replication outcomes or the causal effect of sample size. Randomization concerns criterion presentation order, not assignment to sample-size interventions. The means, t statistic, and p value belong to respondents’ importance ratings. Do not infer causation, population representativeness, nine complete means, or replication rates from these excerpts. The original Fig 5 image is omitted; a teaching comparison must be labeled as a reconstruction from the two reported means, without invented error-bar values.

thread.text: 这部分通过调查心理科学研究者，询问他们认为哪些条件能预测研究可复现性；最终分析样本为 215 位研究者。
在 5 点重要性评分中，“大样本量”均值为 3.84，“大效应量”均值为 3.61；作者报告两者差异 t(214)=3.21、p=0.002。
这些数值回答“受访者如何判断”，不是“任意单篇论文的真实复现概率”。给定材料不能建立 N→复现概率滑块，因此本页保留静态比较和测量边界。

sections.title: 调查测量了什么？
sections.role: 连接受访人群、随机呈现方式与实际测量指标，避免混淆研究样本量和调查人数。

points.text: 调查邀请经社交媒体和 Society for Personality and Social Psychology 邮件列表发出；排除 10 位本科生后，分析 215 位心理科学研究者。
九项研究标准的呈现顺序在参与者间随机化，每项按 5 点尺度评估其被认为能预测可复现性的程度，分数越高表示越重要。
随机化对象是标准的呈现顺序，不是把论文随机分配到不同 N。215 是受访者人数，不是待复现论文的 N；“large sample size”是评分项目。

sections.learning_goal: 区分调查受访人数、被评估论文的样本量、呈现顺序随机化和样本量干预。

sections.title: 读两项评分：均值差异不等于概率差异
sections.role: 保留原始评分单位和报告的统计量，展示可由节选直接支持的比较。

points.text: 作者报告大样本量为最重要标准（M=3.84），大效应量为第二重要标准（M=3.61）；比较统计量为 t(214)=3.21、p=0.002。Fig 5 图注说误差条表示 ±1 SE。
显著性检验在这里针对重要性评分差异；不能把 3.84 解读为 84% 或 3.84/5 的复现概率，也不能把 p 值当作某篇论文复现失败概率。

sections.title: 为什么不能做单篇论文概率滑块？
sections.role: 回应机制请求，把材料能够说明的测量关系与尚未建立的预测关系分开。

points.text: 给定调查的输出是重要性判断，没有提供论文 N 与实际复现成败的逐篇配对数据，也没有在这里给出经过验证的概率函数。仅移动 N 后显示一个概率会制造节选不支持的定量结论。
作者明确指出被复现的研究和调查受访者都不是代表性样本。
因此，这份材料连普遍代表性都不能保证，更不能支持对任意单篇论文作可靠概率预测。论文标题中的预测主张所涉及的其他分析未在所给节选中出现，本页不据标题补齐结论。
若要评估某个概率预测器，至少需要明确复现成功的判据、适用研究范围、真实结果数据、拟合关系及独立验证与不确定性评估。这里把这些当作所缺的信息说明，而不假造其数值。

sections.learning_goal: 说明从研究者主观评分到单篇论文真实复现概率之间缺少哪些证据。

terms.name: 可复现性（本调查中的被评价对象）

explanation.text: 参与者评分的是某项标准被认为能预测研究可复现性的程度，并没有在该调查中直接测出复现成败。
这里要分开 215 位调查受访者和被评分标准“大样本量”；材料未提供可调的单篇论文 N 与概率对应关系。
背景定义：标准误描述估计量在重复抽样中的变动程度。图注所写 ±1 SE 不等于逐篇论文成功概率区间；节选没有给出误差条长度。
